reviews.title: not all labeled live wallpapers are actually live wallpapers
reviews.text:
I figured out why only some anime live wallpapers were actually working after doing all the recommended settings. 

Do not go on anime section in the main page of the app. It will label them all live wallpapers. Instead enter “anime” in the search bar on top and it will show you a tab you can switch from “static” to “live wallpapers” only the ones with it switched to live are real live wallpapers recognized by iPhone. 

The static ones should not have a live icon. They should have an icon that says they are static. 

Giving it 2 stars for terrible labeling/ categorizing , not user friendly, bad instructions and making me feel like I work for your IT department when I just wanted to download a simple live wallpaper.
